name: Patella Alta
definition: High-riding patella relative to the femoral trochlea, an anatomic risk factor for patellar instability and patellofemoral symptoms.

investigations.principle: Lateral radiographs and MRI can quantify patellar height using established indices.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Surgical correction is reserved for selected recurrent instability cases with significant patella alta.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi alignment phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: High-riding patella relative to the femoral trochlea, an anatomic risk factor for patellar instability and patellofemoral symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
